prompt: Draw a C4 context diagram in C4-PlantUML for a hospital appointment booking system, with a Patient, the Booking System, and two external systems: an SMS Gateway and the hospital records system.
Draw a C4 container diagram in C4-PlantUML for a food delivery service: a mobile app, an API, an order database and an external payment provider.
Add an external Email System that the Online Shop uses to send order confirmations to the Customer.
startCode:
@startuml
!include <C4/C4_Context>
Person(customer, "Customer", "Buys products online")
System(shop, "Online Shop", "Lets customers browse and buy")
System_Ext(payments, "Payment Provider", "Processes card payments")
Rel(customer, shop, "Browses and orders")
Rel(shop, payments, "Takes payment through")
@enduml
